programs.description: Krishna loves Mahalakshmi, whose brother works for a don. During a gang fight, the brother asks Krishna to protect some children and return them to their parents.
Karthik falls in love with Sowbhagya on his visit to her village. After marriage, they head to Mysuru, where a mystery connected to her unfolds.
Three strangers desire to make it big in the dog-eat-dog movie industry. When the aspirants stumble into each other, they decide to join forces and conquer their dreams together.
Abhi, a college student in Bangalore, meets Bhanu who stays as a tenant in his house. Despite their differences, they fall in love, which soon sparks trouble in their lives.

In the 1960s, when her father passed away, Suma Aachar's conservative household turned upside down as she had to shoulder the family's responsibilities and navigate her dreams while discovering herself.
Chandrappa believes that his daughter, Lakshmi, brings good luck and his second daughter, Anita, brings bad luck.
While working odd jobs, Aakash, a practical man, meets Nandini, a rich girl, who falls for him, but he does not reciprocate. However, her brothers misunderstand their bond and make his life hell.
After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.
Transferred to a district notorious for its crime, Inspector Seetharam Benoy's diligence and determination have tragic consequences on his personal life.

With the hope of beginning anew, a man returns to his village to sell a piece of his land. On the way, he falls in love with a young woman, only to find out later that her parents want him dead.

Shivalinga, a poor laborer, fails to earn enough money to save his mother's life. Later, he rescues a kidnapped girl and, aiming to fund her education, joins the underworld, leading to chaotic events.

When Varada learns that his rival has killed his sister, he decides to avenge her death. He goes against the wishes of his mother who does not support his reckless methods.
A young aspiring film director who seeks to make his directorial debut decides to use a real-life gangster as inspiration for his first movie.

A senior crime inspector investigates a complex case of people going missing in Bengaluru, taking every measure possible to uncover the truth.
Sangolli Rayanna, the army chief of the Kingdom of Kittur and a freedom fighter, revolts against the British in a bid to oust them from the country.
A man with a hearing and speech impairment secretly loves his twin brother's wife. He tries his best to separate the two, to the extent of following them on their honeymoon.
